name: @playform/hook-dsh-batch-decision
description: The batch-decision hook: the thin workflow owner between the suggester, the pass-on, the ingester and the live view (Documentation/Plans/PASS-ON-AND-INGESTER.md section 5). It listens for batch/proposed events carrying a BatchProposal, runs the decision gate (expiry, the conservative auto-approve policy: the first batch of an intent class always requires the user; an allowlisted, bounded, confident, already-seen intent may auto-approve by policy), records the BatchDecision, emits batch/decision for the ingester and the live view, and exposes the one entry point the user interacts with - the batch_decision tool (list pending proposals, approve/deny by id, with the ingester handoff attempted through the service seam when present). It does NOT implement the pass-on or the ingester; the sibling service shapes are declared structurally in Source/Interface/Siblings.ts and resolved via Context.get at use time (the tool-jobs precedent) - never injected. The workflow ledger is the module's own log file. Ships DISABLED - the idle-forever posture.
